title: Remove Ollama
description: Removes only what llmwizard installed, as listed in its record on the server. An Ollama you installed yourself is left alone. Models are deleted only if you confirm the list.

deleteModels.description: Delete downloaded models too. The app lists them first.

steps.title: Stop and disable the Ollama service
steps.why: The service has to stop before its files are removed.
steps.run: systemctl disable --now ollama 2>/dev/null || systemctl stop ollama 2>/dev/null || true

steps.title: Remove the Ollama service
steps.run:
rm -f /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl reset-failed ollama 2>/dev/null || true

steps.title: Remove the Ollama program and libraries
Delete the downloaded models
steps.why: You confirmed the models should be deleted. They live in /usr/share/ollama.

steps.title: Remove the ollama user and group
steps.why: They were created by llmwizard. Its home folder (with any models) is removed only if you chose to delete the models.
steps.run:
if [ "$P_deleteModels" = yes ]; then
    userdel -r ollama 2>/dev/null || userdel ollama
else
    userdel ollama
fi
groupdel ollama 2>/dev/null || true

steps.title: Forget the ollama folder
steps.why: Bookkeeping only: the models folder was deleted.

steps.title: Remove llmwizard's download cache
steps.why: Leftover downloads in llmwizard's own folder.
